title: BLACK+DECKER® Launches dustbuster® mini™, a Cordless Handheld Vacuum Weighing Under 1 lb.
summary: The dustbuster® mini™ is a compact, cordless handheld vacuum designed to tackle quick cleanups at home, in the car, and on the go Offered in 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 models, the dustbuster® mini™...
body_markdown:
- *The dustbuster® mini™ is a compact, cordless handheld vacuum designed to tackle quick cleanups at home, in the car, and on the go*
- *Offered in 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 models, the dustbuster® mini™ combines handheld vacuuming with high-velocity blowing, with select models also featuring inflation and vacuum-pump functionality*
- *The dustbuster® mini™ is now available at select national retailers, including Amazon, Target, and Walmart.com*


TOWSON, Md.


, Oct. 1, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- BLACK+DECKER®, a Stanley Black & Decker brand, announced today the launch of the dustbuster® mini™, a cordless air tool cleaning solution, designed for quick cleanups and hard-to-reach spaces in the home, car and beyond.


Weighing under 1 lb.* and delivering up to 2X the suction,** the dustbuster® mini™ combines handheld vacuuming and high-velocity blowing capabilities in one portable cleaning tool. Its compact design makes it easy to clean everyday messes in areas that can be difficult to reach with larger vacuums, including seat crevices, vehicle consoles, narrow drawers, vents, keyboards, and other little spaces.


"As a new generation makes the most of personal spaces, from college dorms to first apartments, the dustbuster® mini™ reflects what our brand has always stood for: accessible innovation designed to fit naturally into everyday life," said Michael Barnett, Group Category Manager, BLACK+DECKER.


The dustbuster® mini™ is available in two models: 2-in-1 and 3-in-1. The 3-in-1 model offers the same vacuuming and blowing capabilities, plus inflation and vacuum-pump functions for tasks like inflating pool toys and balloons or shrinking vacuum storage bags.


**Key dustbuster® mini™ features include:**


- **Compact and lightweight:** Weighs under 1 lb. for easy maneuverability and portability
- **Powerful suction:** Delivers up to 2X the suction for quick cleanup of dust, crumbs and everyday debris
- **Vacuum and blower functionality:** Converts from a handheld vacuum into a high-velocity blower
- **3-in-1 option:** Select models add inflation and vacuum-pump functionality
- **Specialized attachments:** Designed to clean flat surfaces, narrow gaps, vehicle vents, keyboards, electronics and other hard-to-reach areas
- **Easy maintenance:** Features a washable dust bowl and filter
- **Portable design:** USB charging capability (adapter sold separately) and an included drawstring storage bag make the unit easy to store or take "on the go"


Functions, pricing, attachments and other product features vary by model and retailer.


The dustbuster® mini™ is now available at select national retailers, including Amazon, Target and Walmart.com.


To learn more about BLACK+DECKER and the dustbuster® mini™, visit[www.blackanddecker.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787741-1&h=560079408&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.blackanddecker.com%2F&a=www.blackanddecker.com) .
